subject.title: Feature Request: Add custom client display name for TUI

question: Should OpenClaw expose a user-facing TUI display-name override, and should it be a CLI-only flag, a persisted config setting, or an automatically derived label?
rationale: The code path is clear, but this adds a public CLI/config-adjacent surface and affects Gateway-visible presence metadata, so automation should not choose naming, persistence, or privacy defaults.

options.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
options.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path that affects only this Gateway-mode process and keeps the current default unchanged.

options.title: Add Persisted TUI Config
options.body: Add a `tui` config key if maintainers want a stable per-user default, with schema, docs, validation, and no upgrade surprise.

options.title: Defer Or Decline
options.body: Keep `openclaw-tui` as the only TUI presence label until a broader TUI identity/privacy policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path that affects only this Gateway-mode process and keeps the current default unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current label history and is the strongest owner signal for the public CLI/product decision.
